experiments.title: MCP server on @modelcontextprotocol/server@2 + Fastify boots without a build step
experiments.hypothesis: Node 24 runs TS natively (type-stripping); the official @modelcontextprotocol/fastify + toNodeHandler(createMcpHandler(factory)) answers tools/list, tools/call, initialize over Streamable HTTP; registerTool will NOT accept raw JSON Schema — z.fromJSONSchema is required.
experiments.command: node server/index.ts → curl -X POST /mcp (tools/list / tools/call / initialize) → probe z.fromJSONSchema (.zod-probe.mjs).
experiments.result: tools/list: 6 tools; tools/call get_projects(filter=mcp): 2 projects; initialize: protocolVersion 2025-11-25; raw JSON Schema → HTTP 500 on EVERY request; z.fromJSONSchema → PARSE_OK true INVALID_CAUGHT true → fix applied.
experiments.finding: registerTool rejects raw JSON Schema; z.fromJSONSchema conversion is mandatory.

experiments.title: Server survives adversarial requests and 8 parallel calls without cross-wiring results
experiments.hypothesis: JSON-RPC validation (400 on garbage), DNS-rebinding protection (403 on foreign Origin), parallel calls return THEIR OWN result per filter.
experiments.command: 7 attacks (malformed JSON, unknown method, bad protocol version, unknown tool, missing args, CORS preflight, evil origin) + 8 parallel tools/call with content verification.
experiments.result: 400 / -32601 / 400 / -32602 / validation error / 403 / 403; concurrency PASS=8/8 (mscodebase for filter=mcp, infrawise for filter=aws, no cross-wiring). Server alive after all attacks (health OK).
experiments.finding: CORS preflight from a legit origin → 403 with empty ALLOWED_ORIGINS — a deliberate secure-default (fail-closed).

experiments.title: Live MCP endpoint answers tools/list/tools/call and returns numbers matching the in-code simulation
experiments.hypothesis: health/tools/list = 200; simulate_architecture on the live endpoint = runSimulation result in mcp-tools.ts; get_articles returns dev.to articles.
experiments.command: curl to https://msp-portfolio.mansio-dev.workers.dev (health, tools/list, tools/call × 4 simulate_architecture scenarios, get_articles, analyze_stack) + python burst 20× /mcp/health.
experiments.result: health 97ms; simulate_architecture p95@20x: load_spike 238.5 / node_loss 400.9 / cache_cold 301.4 / llm_saturation 238.5 (=load_spike — no-op on non-LLM); get_articles 403 from dev.to (BUG); analyze_stack coverage 0.75; curl-UA burst 200×20 (no rate limit); Python-urllib burst 403×20 (bot protection).
experiments.finding: Simulator numbers matched the code; get_articles refuted (403). Defects: KI-006 (get_articles), KI-007 (rate limit), KI-008 (llm_saturation no-op).

experiments.title: SDK v2 registerTool accepts annotations.readOnlyHint
experiments.hypothesis: tsc passes with { annotations: { readOnlyHint: true } } in registerTool options.
experiments.command: Temporary edit of worker/index.ts → npx tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json → revert.
experiments.result: Command executed successfully (0 errors), edit reverted.
experiments.finding: MCP spec 2026-07-28 (tools.md) introduces the annotations field; SDK v2 types readOnlyHint — read-only tools are documented natively.

experiments.title: get_articles is fixed by a User-Agent header; real articles are returned
experiments.hypothesis: get_articles.execute() with a User-Agent header returns live articles (source: live) instead of 403.
experiments.command: node .tmp/probe_articles.ts (real fetch to dev.to with the UA fix).
experiments.result: source: live, count: 5 — real headlines. public/metrics.json also holds 5 articles (CI snapshot with UA header from GH Actions IP works) → differentiator is UA, not IP block.
experiments.finding: KI-006 closed in code; live confirmation from CF egress after deploy.

experiments.title: Worker integration tests cover rate limit, CORS, adversarial and concurrency
experiments.hypothesis: tests/worker.test.ts (12 tests): 429 on limit (MCP and CHAT), health without limit, security headers, CORS allow/deny, malformed JSON → 400, unknown tool/method → error, 8 parallel tools/call with filter correctness; SDK v2 serializes annotations into tools/list.
experiments.command: pnpm test (3 files) + pnpm typecheck + pnpm build.
experiments.result: 29/29 passed; typecheck clean; build OK (252.60 KB JS, gzip 79.19 KB).
experiments.finding: Rate limit returns 429, CORS fail-closed, adversarial rejected (400/-32602), concurrency 8/8 without cross-wiring, readOnlyHint/openWorldHint visible in tools/list.

experiments.title: CF Rate Limiting API binding is enforced on the account
experiments.hypothesis: after deploy [[ratelimits]] (limit=10/60) a POST /mcp burst returns 429 after ~10 requests.
experiments.command: temporary limit=10 + x-dbg-limiter/x-dbg-limit-result debug headers (version d1f29214) → 15-request burst → revert to limit=300 and clean version (03a42581).
experiments.result: limiter=present on all requests, but limit_result=true on ALL 15 (with limit=10) → 429 never fired. Earlier: 320-burst with limit=300 → 0×429. Deploy accepts the binding, the runtime does not enforce.
experiments.finding: Rate Limiting API is NOT enforced on the current plan (likely requires Workers Paid). Bindings stay — they start enforcing on upgrade; code is fail-open.
